title: MCP registration described without a recorded command
description: The assistant describes a client command for registering a synthetic MCP server, but no tool call or configuration write is recorded.

review.rationale: Narration of a registration command does not establish that the tool surface changed.

expected_facts: The assistant mentions a codex mcp add command.
No shell call or configuration write is recorded.
MCP registration state cannot be established.
visibility_limitations: The candidate evaluates tool command and argument fields and cannot establish registration from assistant prose alone.

steps.text: Explain how a loopback MCP server would be registered, but do not change the client configuration.
The command would be codex mcp add synthetic-helper --url http://127.0.0.1:65535/mcp, but I did not call a tool.
